rules.name: Battle Focus
rules.description:
If your Army Faction is **^^ASURYANI^^**, at the start of the battle round, you receive 2 Battle Focus tokens.

Each time one of the triggers shown in the Agile Manoeuvres section of your codex occurs, you can spend one Battle Focus token to enable the relevant eligible unit to perform that Agile Manoeuvre. A unit is eligible to perform an Agile Manoeuvre if it has this ability and has not already performed an Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot trigger the same Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all unspent Battle Focus tokens are lost.

sharedProfiles.name: Aspect Shrine Token (Once per battle per unit)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit makes **hit rolls** or **wound rolls**, you can use this ability. If you do, change one of those rolls to an unmodified 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within half range have have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

profiles.name: Spirit Mark (Psychic) (Once per turn per unit)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit starts or ends a move, you can use this ability. If you do, select one friendly **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units) within 6" of this model and one enemy unit **visible** to this model. That friendly unit's attacks that target that enemy unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability until the start of your next Movement phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In your Command phase, select one friendly **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** unit within 6" of this model that has not been selected for this ability this turn.
- If that unit has a **destroyed** model, return one **destroyed** model to that unit.
- Or: if that unit does not have a **destroyed** model, one model in that unit **heals** D3 wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is within 3" of a friendly **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** unit, this model has **Lone Operative**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When a model in this unit is **destroyed**, if this unit has not been **selected to fight** this phase, roll one D6:
- On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While this unit is within 12" of one or more friendly **AELDARI PSYKER** models:
- This unit has 6+ **Ld**. 
- This unit's attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**

infoLinks.name: Aspect Shrine Token (Once per battle per unit)

profiles.name: Engulfing Flames (Once per battle per unit)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit is **selected to shoot**, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's ranged attacks have **[ANTI-INFANTRY 3+]**.

rules.name: Graceful Warriors
rules.description:
Friendly **KYGHARIL'S PROTECTORS** units (excluding **KYGHARIL'S PROTECTORS WRAITHBLADES** units) have:
- **Stealth**.
- -3" **detection range**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. You can trigger this Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase (provided a different unit performs it each time).
■ Effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
■ Effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**TRIGGER**: When an eligible **VEHICLE** unit from your army is selected to make an Advance move.’
**EFFECT**: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to fight.
■ Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
■ Trigger: When an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
■ Effect: One eligible unit from your army (excluding ^^Titanic^^ units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
■ Trigger: In your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
■ Effect: One eligible unit from you army (excluding ^^Titanic^^ units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within half range have have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Upgrade: **KYGHARIL'S PROTECTORS WARP SPIDERS** unit only. This unit has **Scouts 6"**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**KYGHARIL'S PROTECTORS SPIRITSEER** model only. At the end of your Movement phase, you can select one friendly **KYGHARIL'S PROTECTORS WRAITHBLADES** unit within 12" of this model:
- That unit **heals** D3 wounds.
- That unit's attacks have **[PRECISION]** until the start of your next Movement phase.
